title: Carbon Sequestering Crop Harvests Sunlight CO2 Water Soil Yield Carbon Negative Biofuel Crop
reason: Describes a unique farming system and Caranada crop that sequesters carbon.

tasks.task: Explain the process of how Caranada crops harvest energy and carbon.

subtasks.text: Observe Caranada harvesting energy from the sun, CO2 from the air, and water from the soil.
Note that Caranada returns carbon to the soil, making it a net negative carbon crop.

tasks.task: Describe the goal of growing Caranada on non-food acres.

subtasks.text: Notice the focus on growing Caranada in places where no crop would naturally grow.
Highlight that Caranada creates yield for biofuels and oil products.
